description: This Java test class, LiquibaseUtil, provides utility methods for managing database schema creation and updates using Liquibase within the OpenMRS project. It includes methods for ensuring schema creation, executing changelogs, and logging progress and errors during schema updates. It also contains a nested callback class for logging changelog execution details.

classes.name: LiquibaseUtil
classes.description: A utility class for managing Liquibase database schema updates in the OpenMRS testing environment.

methods.name: ensureSchemaCreated
methods.description: Ensures the database schema is created only once, invoking createSchema() if not already done.

methods.name: createSchema
methods.description: Performs the schema creation and update process, executing the main changelog and subsequent update files, with logging.

inner_classes.name: PrintingChangeSetExecutorCallback
inner_classes.description: A callback class that logs details about each changeset as it is executed during Liquibase update process.

methods.name: executing
methods.description: Logs information about the current changeset being executed, including author, comments, and description.
